Game Overview

Steve and Alex Dragon Egg puts players into a action experience centered on embark on a daring adventure with Steve and Alex as you navigate a perilous labyrinth filled with fiery dragons and explosive monsters. Wield unique abilities, from sword-fighting to path-clearing with a pickaxe, and strategically collaborate to snatch the coveted dragon egg in this action-packed escapade.
